what: 3. lwrite(): writing a list of mixed objects in one call
title: Writing Outputs with ggwrite, ftwrite, and lwrite
text: Often analysis produces mixture outputs - plots, tables - want save together. lwrite() takes named list dispatches element appropriate writer (ggwrite() plots, ftwrite() flextable objects, ), using list names generate file names.  particularly useful end analysis script: collect every plot table want export single named list, call lwrite() instead calling ggwrite()/ftwrite() separately object.
